lines.text: Angry Pharaoh imprisons his chief cupbearer and chief baker, and the captain of the guard assigns them to Joseph.
Both men dream on the same night, and Joseph tells them interpretations belong to God.
The cupbearer dreams of a vine with three branches, and Joseph says the branches are seven days.
Joseph asks the cupbearer to mention him to Pharaoh, because he was kidnapped from the land of the Egyptians.
On his birthday Pharaoh restores the cupbearer and hangs the baker, but the cupbearer forgets Joseph.
